title: 81% of Slovaks back EU membership — so why is Fico trying to rewrite the 2003 accession vote?
lede: Ján Mazá explains why rigging claims by Slovak prime minister Robert Fico show that the leader is either confused or intending to deceive people. The constitutional lawyer warns Ficos' disinformation about Slovakia's EU accession may be paving the way for an EU exit referendum in Slovakia.

title: Consumers pay the price for online manipulation, and the EU Digital Fairness Act can put a stop to it
lede: The EU's Digital Fairness Act (DFA) is one of the few initiatives of this legislative term through which Europe can improve people's lives by strengthening their consumer rights and helping them save money, write the Socialists & Democrats.
